# Codarox AI

> Codarox AI is a multimodal AI assistant by Codarox.

## Product
- Live application: https://codaroxai.codarox.com/
- Codarox: https://codarox.com/
- Case study: https://codarox.com/pages/codarox-ai.html
- Source: https://github.com/Armin-000/CodaroxAI

## Capabilities
- AI conversations and coding assistance
- Document and image analysis
- AI image generation
- Streaming responses
- Conversation history
